market_question: Will Anthropic’s market cap be between $300B and $400B at market close on IPO day?
reasoning: Anthropic’s valuation as of March 2025 is ~$61.5B. While reaching a $300B market cap by mid-2026 requires a ~5x increase in a little over a year, the company’s revenue growth is explosive (from $1M to $1B in 2024) and AI hype could drive extreme valuations. Even with a low probability of an IPO by June 2026 and a narrow valuation window, the true odds of YES are likely closer to 1% than the market’s 0.2%.
evidence_points: Anthropic raised $3.5B at a $61.5B valuation in March 2025 (Forbes).
Annualized revenue reached ~$1B in December 2024, up from $1M a year earlier, showing a path to multi‑billion revenues by 2026.
The narrow $300B–$400B window and tight IPO deadline keep probability low, but not as low as implied by current price.
sources_consulted: Forbes reporting on Anthropic funding round (March 2025)
